sv.title: Jair Bolsonaro vårdas på intensiven
sv.summary: Brasiliens ex-president Jair Bolsonaro har lagts in på intensivvårdsavdelning i huvudstaden Brasília, rapporterar Reuters. Enligt sjukhuset har han drabbats av akut tarmvred. Han uppges vara vid medvetande och läget uppges vara stabilt.

en.title: Jair Bolsonaro being treated in intensive care
en.summary: Brazil's former president Jair Bolsonaro has been admitted to an intensive care unit in the capital Brasília, Reuters reports. According to the hospital, he has suffered an acute intestinal volvulus. He is reportedly conscious and his condition is reported to be stable.
